parameters.name: UPnPArchitecture
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the major version of the supported UPnP architecture. If UPnP 1.1 is supported the value is 1. If UPnP 2.0 is supported the value is 2. A value of 0 indicates no UPnP support.

parameters.name: UPnPArchitectureMinorVer
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the minor version of the supported UPnP architecture. If UPnP 1.1 is supported the value is 1. If UPnP 2.0 is supported the value is 0. If {{param|UPnPArchitecture}} is 0 then this parameter SHOULD be ignored.

parameters.name: UPnPMediaServer
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Media Server. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPMediaRenderer
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Media Renderer. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPWLANAccessPoint
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Wireless Access Point. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPBasicDevice
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Basic Device. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPQoSDevice
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Qos Device. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPQoSPolicyHolder
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP Qos Policy Holder. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPIGD
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP IGD. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPDMBasicMgmt
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP-DM Basic Management. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPDMConfigurationMgmt
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP-DM Configuration Management. A value of 0 indicates no support.

parameters.name: UPnPDMSoftwareMgmt
parameters.description: Numeric value indicating the supported revision for UPnP-DM Software Management. A value of 0 indicates no support.

object.description: This object defines what UPnP capabilities this device has.
